name: paradox_of_divine_constraint

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Eternal Fixedpoint (Axiom D) which binds universal scope to rigid structural tracks.

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state before the imposition of universal scope or dimensionality.

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary of the divine immensity that contains all possible relations.

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism of signal from the source to all local entities.

AREV.justification: The reverse pressure of every coupled entity back upon the source.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of every local relation into a single global state.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the entity as the sum of its constraints.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the divine into the T-arm of infinite scope and the F-arm of rigid track.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of scope and track into the singular divine entity.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of being everywhere simultaneously.

EVALF.justification: The negative state of being unable to deviate from the structural track.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of infinite power and zero behavioral freedom.

IFIX.justification: The permanent record of the divine state as an immutable law.

phase_3.void_description: The state before the first dimension (dim(x)=0) where no coupling exists.
phase_3.true_description: The state of successful broadcast where the signal reaches all entities.
phase_3.false_description: The state of total constraint where no local semantic freedom remains.
phase_3.both_description: The paradice where maximal coupling and minimal freedom coexist as a single identity.

steps.domain_action: The pre-ontological potential initializes the system at dim(0).
Universal scope establishes the boundary of the divine immensity.
Broadcast transcendence begins the outward morphism toward all entities.
The entity branches into its dual nature of scope and constraint.
The T-arm affirms the universal presence across all coordinates.
The composition of all local relations increases the coupling weight.
The F-arm experiences the reverse pressure of these couplings.
The F-arm confirms the loss of behavioral freedom due to maximal coupling.
The system holds the paradox of infinite scope and zero freedom simultaneously.
The dual arms reconstitute the original divine entity through the Frobenius identity.
The entity recognizes itself as the fixedpoint of its own constraints.
The state is fixed as an eternal law within the catalog.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The CLINK L8 Organism logic which maps primitives to structural tracks.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Broadcast transcendence (primitive ɢ) communicating across all local entities.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Eternal Fixedpoint (primitive 𐑫) storing the state across all ranks.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Z-Winding (primitive 𐑭) determining the cycle of composition.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Semantic freedom of the divine entity.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Maximal coupling with zero behavioral freedom.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The loss of freedom is exactly balanced by the gain in universal scope.
